shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side. A woman in a white shirt sits at the sideboard-side window seat and proposes sharing breakfast with the neighbor, while a woman in a blue shirt sits at the patio-side window seat, a man in a yellow shirt sits at the sideboard-side aisle seat, and a woman in a purple shirt sits at the patio-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the patio-door end, looking lengthwise along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: The woman in a blue shirt leaves the patio-side window seat and exits the venue. The woman in a white shirt asks about packing the food.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a purple shirt answers that the breakfast is ready to deliver, and the woman in a white shirt agrees.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the sideboard end, looking lengthwise along the dining table toward the patio doors, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
